regions.name: Western Meher-producing areas
regions.where: The whole western half: Tigray, western and central Amhara, Benishangul-Gumuz, Gambela, western Oromia (Wellegas, Jimma, Illubabor, West Shewa), South West Ethiopia and the Guraghe-Hadiya-Kembata area (purple on the locator map)
regions.notes: Exact edges: lean box Jun to mid-Aug; long-cycle planting mid-Apr to end-May (before the shaded Kiremt period, linked to Kiremt as the only rainy season in the block, which produces the Meher harvest); short-cycle planting mid-Jun to end-Aug. Green Meher harvest Aug-Sep not counted.

regions.name: Belg and Meher-producing areas
regions.where: A central highland band: eastern Amhara (North and South Wello, North Shewa) and southern Tigray, then from around Addis Ababa through East Shewa, Arsi, Bale highlands and Hararghe, and south-west through Sidama, Gedeo, Wolayita, Gamo, Gofa, Konso and Guji (purple on the locator map)
regions.notes: Exact edges: Belg Rains mid-Feb to mid-May; Kiremt Rains mid-Jun to mid-Sep; Belg harvest mid-Jun to mid-Aug; Meher harvest Oct to mid-Dec; short-cycle planting mid-Feb to end-Mar; lean box Mar-May. Long-cycle planting falls in the Belg rains, but these crops are harvested with the Meher harvest. Green harvest (Belg late Jun, Meher Aug-Sep) not counted.

regions.name: Northern pastoral areas
regions.where: Afar Region plus northern Somali Region (Siti and the Jijiga/Fafan area) (purple on the locator map)
regions.notes: Lean box is drawn in two pieces: Jan to mid-Mar, plus a sliver from just after mid-December (covers about 45% of Dec, so Dec is not counted under the half-month rule; the box effectively runs from late Dec). Karan/Karma rains end at mid-Sep (counted). No crop rows.

regions.name: Southern pastoral areas
regions.where: Southern and south-eastern lowlands: most of Somali Region (south of Fafan/Siti), Borena and East Bale in Oromia, and the far south of South Omo along the Kenya border (purple on the locator map)
regions.notes: Exact edges: lean box mid-Jan to mid-Mar (both months exactly half-covered, counted); Deyr/Hageya rains Oct to mid-Dec (counted). No crop rows.

assign.method: Approximate zone centroids were plotted on the four purple locator maps (calibrated to Ethiopia's extent); each zone went to the map that covers it, and each region to the block holding most of its zones/people, with adm2 overrides for split regions.

transcriber_notes: Edges measured on the full-resolution image; many fall exactly at mid-month and were counted (at-least-half rule); exact half-month edges are listed in each region's notes. Locator-map boundaries are only approximate. Uncertain zones: South Omo (mostly belg-meher on the map, southern strip pastoral; left in belg-meher), Borena (on both maps; put in southern-pastoral as it is mainly pastoral), Guji and Bale (belg-meher, but their lowlands are pastoral), Erer (southern-pastoral), Finfine Special zone and Addis Ababa (at the junction of the western and belg-meher maps; belg-meher), Dire Dawa (at the edge of the northern-pastoral map; low confidence), Fafan (a small lobe on the northern-pastoral map around Jijiga). Southern Tigray is on the belg-meher map. No harvest or lean labels other than 'Lean Season'.
